title: On the relation between the product of KK-groups and the KK-group of the product
summary: We observe that the canonical map \(KK(A, \prod_{n \in \mathbb{N}} B_n) \to \prod_{n \in \mathbb{N}} KK(A,B_n)\) is an isomorphism of abelian groups whenever \(A\) enjoys the Universal Coefficient Theorem and \(B_n\) are unital, simple and purely infinite C*-algebras. This clarifies an aspect of previous work of Dadarlat--Eilers and Tikuisis--White--Winter.
